core_obligations: Forward implication: dividing by a nonzerodivisor preserves the Gorenstein property (proof lines 4116-4118)

Backward implication: assume the quotient is Gorenstein, so its Ext modules against the residue field eventually vanish, and compute the corresponding Ext modules over the source by adjunction, where the internal hom out of the quotient is the quotient shifted by one (proof lines 4119-4130)
Conclude: the eventual vanishing over the source gives that the source is Gorenstein by the same criterion (proof lines 4131-4132)
proof_roadmap: A Gorenstein ⇒ B Gorenstein 由 divide-by-nonzerodivisor 引理。
反向：B Gorenstein ⇒ Ext^i_B(k, B) 当 i >> 0 为零（gorenstein-ext 判别）。
由 right-adjoint 与直接计算：RHom_A(k, A) = RHom_B(k, RHom(B,A)) = RHom_B(k, B[1])，故 Ext^i_A(k,A) 大指数消失 ⇒ 由判别 A 是 Gorenstein。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement says that for a nonzerodivisor in the maximal ideal of a Noetherian local ring the ring is Gorenstein exactly when the quotient by that element is (author lemma at source lines 4108-4113, label lemma-gorenstein-divide-by-nonzerodivisor). The proof (source lines 4116-4133) takes the forward implication from the preservation statement, and for the converse rewrites the Ext modules of the residue field over the source by adjunction along the quotient map, using that the internal hom out of the quotient is the quotient shifted by one, so that eventual vanishing over the quotient transfers to the source and the vanishing criterion applies (proof lines 4119-4132). The adjunction computation is the substance. H3.
